summary: ProShares Trust II filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, announcing reverse share splits for two of its ETFs: ProShares Ultra Bloomberg Natural Gas (BOIL) at a 1-for-2 ratio and ProShares UltraShort Bloomberg Crude Oil (SCO) at a 1-for-4 ratio, effective May 28, 2026. The splits adjust per-share pricing without altering shareholder investment value. BOIL gets a new CUSIP 74347Y664; SCO gets 74347Y656. Fractional shares will be redeemed for cash, potentially triggering taxable events. This is a routine fund maintenance action, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic change involved.
